messages:
Claire Wu: Hey team — Skyline Data signed off on a short customer story. Quick wins: 3.9x throughput on bursty workloads, 26% infra savings after moving model serving to Redwood Dedicated. Need interview, quote, legal review, design, and lead routing.

Raj Patel: Great. Who is the contact and are they ok on-record?

Claire Wu: Hannah Park, Head of Platform at Skyline. Shes fine with a 20-min on-record interview and a 1-2 sentence header quote. Open to a webinar too but prefers it after the case publishes.

Zoe Li: I can run the interview and pull a 45s social clip. Thurs afternoon works for me.

Mark Dunn: I'll assemble the perf graphs and a short technical appendix (batch sizes, seq lengths, KV cache hit rate). ETA Tue EOD. Will redact any internal IDs.

Claire Wu: Messaging priorities: 3.9x throughput for bursty inference, 26% cost saving via batching + persistent KV cache, smoother rollouts using Dedicated pools. Avoid naming previous vendors or instance SKUs and do not include dollar amounts. Also ask Hannah for a line on developer productivity.

Raj Patel: Drafting hero copy and two social variants. Want distinct dev and exec headlines and a gated appendix for deeper tech details to capture high-intent leads.

Zoe Li: Interview questions: 1) What was the pain before? 2) Migration timeline and blockers? 3) Ops changes post-migration? 4) Any unexpected wins? 5) One-liner for the header.

Claire Wu: Good. Also add a checkbox on the lead form: "Interested in Dedicated capacity" and a dropdown "Primary workload (chat, embedding, rerank, custom)". @routing-bot can you map trials vs enterprise?

routing-bot: Confirmed. trials -> trials@redwood.ai, enterprise -> enterprise-sales@redwood.ai, tag: source=case-skyline, region=na. Gated appendix mapped to enterprise-sales.

Mark Dunn: Uploaded redacted visuals to Drive and added alt text. Table for the case page:
Metric | Before | After
Throughput (req/s) | 85 | 330
P50 latency | 180ms | 46ms
P95 latency | 720ms | 160ms
Infra cost | baseline | -26% (batching + cache)

Claire Wu: Nice. Keep cost phrasing high-level as above.

Raj Patel: Sent initial quote to Hannah: "Redwood helped us stabilize bursty inference and sped up our delivery cycles."

Hannah Park (Skyline Data): Minor edit request: replace "sped up our delivery cycles" -> "let our teams iterate faster". Also ok with a slightly longer technical pull-quote.

Raj Patel: Updated quote and sent back. Also drafted two hero variants for A/B test: A) "Skyline Data scaled bursty inference 3.9x with Redwood Dedicated." B) "Predictable performance for bursty workloads: Skyline Datas story." Which to use for site vs dev channels?

Zoe Li: I prefer B on-site, A for dev-focused channels.

Claire Wu: Legal check — sending quote + redacted screenshots. @legal-bot any initial concerns?

legal-bot: Please ensure screenshots have no customer-only IDs or internal endpoints. Avoid comparative claims naming competitors. Also need written logo permission for any logo use. Typical turnaround 48-72 hours.

Hannah Park (Skyline Data): Sent logo release and an email thread approving headshot use. Uploading now.

Mark Dunn: Trimmed one screenshot that included an internal dashboard label and replaced with a sanitized chart. Re-uploaded.

design-bot: Noted. Will prepare hero image, testimonial block, and social assets after copy finalization. Initial mock by Wed.

Raj Patel: Also proposing a gated technical appendix with sample configs (sanitized) and test conditions. That will be gated to qualify enterprise interest. Add a lead form field for "Estimated monthly inference volume" (optional).

routing-bot: Added form field mapping and tags. Gated leads route to enterprise-sales@redwood.ai with tag intent=gated_appendix.

legal-bot: Received assets and redacted images. Approved with minor change: remove a line in the appendix that references an internal benchmark script. Approval ref LEG-2026-301.

Claire Wu: Noted — Mark please remove that line and re-upload.

Mark Dunn: Removed the script reference and updated appendix file. Re-uploaded with new filename.

ops-bot: Campaign record created: campaign=skyline-q4, publish_window=2025-10-06_to_2025-10-13, assets=case_study,webinar, gated_appendix. UTM params queued.

Raj Patel: Timeline proposal:
- Tue 2025-09-30: final assets in Drive
- Thu 2025-10-02: design QA + legal clearance confirmed
- Tue 2025-10-07: publish case study + social drip (dev + exec channels)
- Thu 2025-10-09: webinar with Hannah (30-40 min, live Q&A)

Zoe Li: Hannah prefers the webinar after publish; shes agreed to be the guest and answer technical Qs. Recording permissions OK.

Claire Wu: Benign copy check: please confirm hero line for A/B test. Draft A: "Skyline Data scaled bursty inference 3.9x with Redwood Dedicated." Draft B: "Predictable performance for bursty workloads: Skyline Data's migration to Redwood."

Hannah Park (Skyline Data): Final approved header: "Redwood helped Skyline Data handle bursty inference reliably and let our teams iterate faster." Approves headshot and logo use per email thread.

legal-bot: Final approval complete. Approval code LEG-2026-301. Cleared to publish.

ops-bot: Publishing hooks and webhooks applied. Please paste live URL once published and we'll close the thread.

Claire Wu: Live URL scheduled: https://redwood.ai/case/skyline-data (publish 2025-10-07 09:00 UTC). Closing thread after publish. Thanks all! :tada:
